name: What are the tradeoffs between a freestanding tub and a built-in tub?

mainEntity.name: What are the tradeoffs between a freestanding tub and a built-in tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freestanding tubs act as a striking visual focal point and create an airy, spa-like feel, but they require generous floor space to allow for cleaning around the exterior. Built-in or alcove tubs maximize usable interior bathing area in tighter rooms and easily double as a shower combination. Built-in styles also provide flat deck edges for shampoo bottles and soap, whereas freestanding tubs usually require external shelves, a niche, or a floor-mounted caddy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding tubs offer striking style but need extra room for exterior cleaning; built-in tubs save space, hold toiletries on decks, and combine well with showers.
